parameters.name: Force
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to forcibly delete the ASM instance. Valid values:

*   `true`: forcibly deletes the ASM instance.
*   `false`: does not forcibly delete the ASM instance.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: RetainResources
parameters.description: A JSON string that can be parsed into a string array. You can use this JSON string to specify the IDs of the resource instances that need to be retained when the ASM instance is deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh delete-service-mesh --service-mesh-id c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --biz-force false --retain-resources lb-bp1fxvl3q8akbj6m00000_,_lb-bp1hoxkolggdw0y300000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh DeleteServiceMesh --region cn-hangzhou --RetainResources 'lb-bp1fxvl3q8akbj6m00000_,_lb-bp1hoxkolggdw0y300000' --ServiceMeshId c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --Force false
